results.title: Yes, primarily at Korala. Rasuwagadhi and Tatopani (the usual main routes for Chinese EVs) have been closed or heavily disrupted by floods a
results.description: Yes, primarily at Korala. Rasuwagadhi and Tatopani (the usual main routes for Chinese EVs) have been closed or heavily disrupted by floods and landslides since late August. Trade was diverted there, so Korala cleared 6,501 EVs (mid-July–Oct 30). National Q1 total was ~6,636 EVs overall; China supplied most, nearly all via Korala. Limited activity has resumed at Rasuwagadhi but remains minor.
